g.text: Read the equation, substitute concrete values, then interpret the result. Numbers on this page are illustrative, not benchmark measurements.

g.text: Count each distinct evaluated line that passes the validity checks.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Count again, now requiring the minimum score too. Finally choose

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: the highest score among those selectable lines.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: X: distinct evaluated candidates; V: pass/fail checks; s: ranking score.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: Y: valid count; U: selectable count; tau_s: score threshold; s*: best selectable score.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #168574
font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: The flow requires 9 syllables. Four distinct lines

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: have been evaluated. Assume other validity tests pass.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Use an illustrative score threshold of 75.

g.text: Toy 0-100 scores, not the production score calibration.

text.style: font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171
font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #168574
font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Valid-count targets and score thresholds are separate rules. Raising the toy threshold to 90 leaves Y = 3

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: but U = 0; then no best selectable score exists. None of these scores directly measures intelligibility.
